questions.stem: Which of the following statements is false about the surgical anatomy of the lungs?

options.label: A
options.text: There are 10 bronchopulmonary segments on the right lung.

options.label: B
options.text: Each bronchopulmonary segment has a separate lymphatic drainage.

options.label: C
options.text: The tracheobronchial tree is normally lined by pseudostratified ciliated columnar cells.

options.label: D
options.text: Segmentectomy is done after locating the segmental branch of bronchial artery.
